svg.title: Sheet 01 (#782): Notifications, plain view, 1280 and 390 px
svg.text: 01 · Notifications: what attendees can be told about (organisers)
Drawn first for the PO (#782 item 4). 1280 px on the left, 390 px on the right. The page keeps its name and address.
Choose what attendees can be notified about. Each person picks which of these they want in their hub.
Open the event on its https address. The platform admin adds one.
Send a test to the crew
Switch off a kind and nobody at this event gets it. People's own choices are kept.
Reminders before things start in the run of show, and when they move or are cancelled.

1 The page's description: one sentence under the title, as on every organiser page.
2 The health box: each check OK or what is missing and what to do. 'Send a test to the crew' goes to organisers and crew only, never to attendees.
3 Each kind in plain words, with an example of what a phone shows, filled in with demo values.
4 One switch per kind: on or off for this event. It saves at once; the notice offers Undo. 5 The notice after a switch.
Tooltips (white box): on the 'i' marks and on every switch, by hover or keyboard focus on a PC, by a tap on a phone.
